title: Manager, Corporate Development - M&A Origination & Deal Sourcing
description: Gemini Group (csigemini.Com) is part of Constellation Software Inc. (TSX: CSU), a global acquirer, builder, and manager of vertical market software businesses. Gemini partners with high-quality software companies, providing long-term operational support, capital, and strategic guidance to help them grow sustainably. Our portfolio spans multiple vertical markets and operates through decentralized business units that are deeply embedded in their respective industries. Learn more here: csigemini.Com The Role The Manager, Corporate Development will play a critical role in identifying, building, and nurturing strategic relationships that lead to new acquisition opportunities for Gemini Group. In this role, you will engage with software company leaders. Your success will be measured by your ability to cultivate meaningful, trust-based relationships that ultimately result in Gemini acquiring high-quality software businesses. Relationship-building in this role is a long-term endeavor - often taking multiple years from first contact to acquisition. Success requires persistence, strategic thinking, disciplined pipeline management, high-quality market research, and a consistent ability to add value across many conversations. As Gemini continues to expand its presence globally, this Brazil based role will also play a foundational part in helping build and scale Gemini’s M&A capability in the LATAM market. Over time, the Manager, Corporate Development will have the opportunity to contribute to the growth of a localized M&A function - including shaping best practices and helping establish Gemini as a preferred partner for LATAM software entrepreneurs. This is a unique chance to be an early builder of Gemini’s deal-sourcing footprint in Brazil while advancing your own leadership trajectory within the organization. Key Outcomes Develop, manage, and expand an M&A pipeline using Salesforce CRM, including market mapping within assigned software verticals. Meet and exceed weekly and quarterly sourcing and relationship-building KPIs. Work both independently and in collaboration with Gemini’s M&A leadership to efficiently evaluate potential acquisition opportunities. Ensure accurate categorization and allocation of leads within relevant portfolio verticals. Effectively screen and qualify opportunities at the top of the acquisition funnel to support Portfolio Managers and operating teams. Support the long-term build-out of Gemini’s LATAM/Brazil M&A presence by contributing to sourcing processes, knowledge sharing, and future team development. Engage directly with founders, CEOs, and controlling shareholders, conducting high-quality M&A conversations to understand ownership dynamics, M&A insights, motivations, business insights and timing of a future, potential deal. Qualify opportunities through initial commercial, operational, and financial assessment, filtering deals before internal escalation. Coordinate internally with global teams (Perseus / CSI) to align on pipeline prioritization and strategic fit. Maintain structured tracking of interactions and insights (CRM-driven), ensuring continuity and depth of relationship over time. Relevant Experience & Competencies At least three years of experience in M&A business development, with proven involvement in various aspects of M&A such as mandate origination (including private equity), initial contact with key decision-makers, deal negotiation, or client-facing roles in M&A or finance within the software or technology sector. Experience in outbound deal origination planning. Previous exposure on relationship-building meetings (virtual or in-person) with company owners to explore strategic M&A opportunities. Demonstrated interest in building a long-term career in software investing, M&A, or corporate development. Track record of high performance in business development, entrepreneurship, or other competitive environments. Strong executive presence with the ability to confidently engage senior leaders, including CEOs, investors, and advisors. Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working autonomously. Self-motivated, proactive, and results-driven with a strong sense of urgency. Other Requirements Willingness to travel occasionally within Brazil and broader LATAM as well as internationally to Canada, the U.S., and Portugal. Professional working proficiency in both English and Portuguese is required. Professional working proficiency in Spanish is a bonus.

title: Cozinheiro(A)
description:

title: Tech Lead Ruby On Rails
description:
Grupo Smart Fit, a força que ativa o seu potencial. O Grupo Smart Fit é a maior plataforma de fitness e bem-estar da América Latina e um dos grupos que mais crescem no mundo. Com atuação em mais de 16 países, mais de 2.000 unidades, mais de 23 mil colaboradores e um ecossistema completo de marcas, impactamos milhões de pessoas todos os dias por meio de experiências que promovem saúde, movimento e qualidade de vida. Aqui, fazer parte do time é crescer junto. Buscamos pessoas que queiram treinar para evoluir sempre, assumir protagonismo na carreira e construir uma trajetória sólida dentro de um grupo forte, em constante expansão e movimento. Trabalhar no Grupo Smart Fit é levar na carreira a força de um grande grupo global, com visão de longo prazo, estrutura robusta e oportunidades reais de crescimento, mobilidade entre marcas e novos desafios ao longo da jornada. Tudo isso em uma cultura de alta performance, forte, colaborativa e conectada ao nosso propósito. Nosso ecossistema reúne marcas que atuam em diferentes frentes do fitness e bem-estar: academias como Smart Fit, Bio Ritmo e Nation CT;
studios como Race Bootcamp, Vidya Studio, Jab House, Tonus Gym, Aera Pilates, Velocity e Kore;
e produtos digitais, TotalPass e Queima Diária. Principais responsabilidades: 1. Liderança Técnica e Arquitetura Guardião da Base de Código: Definir e zelar pelos padrões de código (\ "The Rails Way\"), garantindoque a API seja sólida para os projetos Web e Mobile. Tomada de Decisão Técnica: Escolher as melhores tecnologias, bibliotecas e padrões que equilibrem rapidez de entrega com sustentabilidade futura. Apoio à Gestão: Ser o braço direito do Gerente de TI e do GP, ajudando na estimativa de prazos, viabilidade de features e priorização técnica do backlog. 2. Qualidade, Integração e Homologação Garantia de Eficiência no Processo: Homologar as integrações da API com os times de Front-end (Web e Mobile), garantindo que os contratos de dados sejam cumpridos e a performance seja máxima. Revisão de Código (Code Review): Liderar as revisões de código dos parceiros, assegurando que nenhum débito técnico crítico entre em produção. Estratégia de Testes: Definir a política de cobertura de testes e garantir que o time utilize mocks e ferramentas como VCR para manter a agilidade no desenvolvimento. 3. Sustentação, Suporte e Performance Atendimento de Chamados Nível 3: Atuar como ponto focal em problemas complexos de produção, realizando a análise de causa raiz e orientando o time na correção definitiva. Otimização Contínua: Monitorar gargalos de performance no servidor e no banco de dados, implementando melhorias proativas para suportar o crescimento do app. 4. Aprendizado e Melhoria Contínua Radar Tecnológico: Manter o time atualizado com as novas versões do Ruby e do Rails, avaliando quando migrar ou adotar novas práticas. Cultura de Inovação Pragmática: Estimular o uso de ferramentas de IA para ganho de produtividade, sem abrir mão da segurança e da qualidade do código. O que buscamos Pessoas que: Dominem Arquitetura de Sistemas com Ruby on Rails: Domínio profundo de Rails em modo API e Monolitos, com habilidade para desenhar arquiteturas escaláveis, modulares e de fácil manutenção. Têm experiência com Design de APIs e Contratos: Expertise em arquitetura RESTful, versionamento e, principalmente, na definição de contratos de dados que atendam de forma eficiente Web e Mobile. Têm experiência com Engenharia de Testes Avançada: Domínio total de RSpec, incluindo estratégias complexas de mocking com VCR e WebMock, garantindo pipelines de CI/CD rápidos e determinísticos. Têm experiência com Modelagem e Performance de Dados: Maestria em PostgreSQL, otimização de queries, gestão de índices e estratégias de cache (Redis) para suportar aplicações de alta performance. Têm experiência com Segurança e Infraestrutura: Conhecimento sólido em protocolos de segurança (OAuth2, JWT), além de familiaridade com Docker e ambientes de deploy (AWS/Heroku/DigitalOcean). Adotem estrategicamente a IA: Capacidade de liderar o time no uso eficiente de ferramentas como GitHub Copilot ou Cursor para acelerar a geração de código, testes e documentação. Tenham pragmatismo e visão de Negócio: Foco em entregar a melhor solução técnica que respeite os prazos e objetivos da empresa, evitando\ "overengineering\". Tenham Liderança e Mentoria: Capacidade de elevar o nível técnico dos devs Plenos e Juniores através de Code Reviews educativos e suporte constante. Tenham Comunicação Estratégica e Proativa: Habilidade de traduzir requisitos de negócio (GP) em tarefas técnicas e alinhar expectativas com os times de Front/Mobile para evitar bloqueios. Têm experiência com Gestão de Crises e Decisão: Calma e assertividade para tomar decisões técnicas difíceis sob pressão e resolver incidentes críticos em produção. Tenham Atitude de Dono: Comprometimento total com a qualidade do produto final, antecipando gargalos e propondo melhorias antes que se tornem problemas.

title: Especialista Em Infraestrutura Azure
description:
A PSM Company é especializada na identificação de Talentos para as áreas de TI / Telecom como também para as áreas operacionais e administrativas. Nossa história de sucesso, está baseada em nosso modelo de negócios que proporcionam assertividade e qualidade no processo seletivo, baixo Turn Over e isenção de riscos e passivos trabalhistas.


O que Buscamos?


Especialista em infraestrutura Sênior


Descrição:


**Azure Storage – Fundamentos e Arquitetura**

- Arquitetura de conta do Azure Storage e considerações de design;

- Serviços de storage: Blob Storage, Azure Files, Azure Disks, Queue e Table Storage;

- Camadas de desempenho e opções de redundância (LRS, ZRS, GRS, GZRS);

- Planejamento decapacidade, escalabilidade e otimização de custos;

- Gerenciamento do ciclo de vida dos dados e estratégias de tiering;


**Azure Files**

- Arquitetura do Azure Files e protocolos suportados (SMB, NFS);

- Integração de identidade com Azure AD e Active Directory;

- Camadas de desempenho para file share e casos de uso;

- Cenários de migração a partir de file servers on-premises;

- Alta disponibilidade, snapshots e integração com backup;


**Azure Networking – Conceitos Fundamentais**

- Virtual Networks (VNets), subnets e endereçamento IP

- Segurança de rede com NSGs e Azure Firewall

- Padrões de conectividade: VPN Gateway, ExpressRoute

- Private Endpoints e service endpoints

- Conceitos de DNS e resolução de nomes no Azure;


**Monitoramento e Observabilidade**

- Monitoramento de componentes de Azure Storage, Azure Files e Azure Networking;

- Integração com Azure Monitor e Azure Network Watcher;

- Métricas de throughput, latência, disponibilidade e erros;

- Monitoramento de storage accounts, file shares e recursos de rede

Logs e Analytics;

- Integração com Log Analytics Workspace;

- Análise de logse métricas usando Kusto Query Language (KQL);

- Criação de Workbooks e dashboards para visibilidade da infraestrutura;

- Monitoramento proativo e insights operacionais;


**Backup, Recuperação e Resiliência**

- Conceitos de backup e recuperação para Azure Storage e Azure Files;

- Integração com Azure Backup e Recovery Services Vault;

- Estratégias de snapshot e validação de restore;

- Retenção de dados e requisitos de conformidade;


**Segurança, Governança e Conformidade**

- Melhores práticas de segurança para Azure Storage e Azure Networking

- Criptografia em repouso e em trânsito

- Identidade, controle de acesso e design de RBAC

- Governança com Azure Policy e estratégias de tagging

- Proteção contra exfiltração de dados e misconfiguration



Contratação CLT

title: Project Manager
description:
Data Center Project Manager


Datacenter People is working with one of the leading data center commissioning and quality services firms in the world. Our client is a global professional services firm supporting the delivery of mission critical and data centre infrastructure projects. Acting as an owner’s representative, they provide commissioning management, project oversight and technical advisory services across complex developments.


Due to continued growth in Brazil , they are seeking an experienced Project Manager to oversee commissioning delivery across multiple data center projects.


The Role


  • Lead the delivery of commissioning projects across mission critical data center environments.
  • Manage project delivery across commissioning levels L1–L5, overseeing client relationships, project teams and financial performance.
  • Act as the Competent Person for project safety, ensuring JHAs, toolbox talks and site safety requirements are completed.
  • Manage project schedules, resources and budgets using internal project management and planning systems.
  • Forecast resource requirements, manage billing projections and monitor project expenses.
  • Identify scope changes and manage the change order process with clients.
  • Coordinate commissioning teams including engineers, contractors, vendors and client representatives.
  • Support commissioning activities including design reviews, testing procedures, integrated systems testing (IST) and final commissioning documentation.
  • The Experience Profile
  • Strong understanding of engineering principles within mission critical environments.
  • Technical background in electrical or mechanical systems.
  • Electrical candidates should be comfortable working with three-phase AC power systems, DC systems and live electrical infrastructure.
  • Mechanical candidates should have experience with chilled water systems and commercial HVAC infrastructure.
  • Experience working within data centre commissioning or critical infrastructure projects.
  • Ability to work closely with clients and project stakeholders.
  • Experience reviewing shop drawings, submittals and preparing field reports.


We regret that due to the high volume of applications we are unable to acknowledge each one. Please bear in mind that if you are selected for interview we will contact you within the next seven days.

title: Manager, Corporate Development - M&A Origination & Deal Sourcing
description:
Gemini Group (csigemini.Com) is part of Constellation Software Inc. (TSX: CSU), a global acquirer, builder, and manager of vertical market software businesses. Gemini partners with high-quality software companies, providing long-term operational support, capital, and strategic guidance to help them grow sustainably. Our portfolio spans multiple vertical markets and operates through decentralized business units that are deeply embedded in their respective industries. Learn more here: csigemini.Com


The Role

The Manager, Corporate Development will play a critical role in identifying, building, and nurturing strategic relationships that lead to new acquisition opportunities for Gemini Group.


In this role, you will engage with software company leaders. Your success will be measured by your ability to cultivate meaningful, trust-based relationships that ultimately result in Gemini acquiring high-quality software businesses. Relationship-building in this role is a long-term endeavor - often taking multiple years from first contact to acquisition. Success requires persistence, strategic thinking, disciplined pipeline management, high-quality market research, and a consistent ability to add value across many conversations.


As Gemini continues to expand its presence globally, this Brazil based role will also play a foundational part in helping scale Gemini’s M&A capability in the LATAM market. Over time, the Manager, Corporate Development will have the opportunity to contribute to the growth of a localized M&A function - including shaping best practices and helping establish Gemini as a preferred partner for LATAM software entrepreneurs. This is a unique chance to be a builder of Gemini’s deal-sourcing footprint in Brazil while advancing your own leadership trajectory within the organization.


Key Outcomes

  • Develop, manage, and expand an M&A pipeline using Salesforce CRM, including market mapping within assigned software verticals.
  • Meet and exceed weekly and quarterly sourcing and relationship-building KPIs.
  • Work both independently and in collaboration with Gemini’s M&A leadership to efficiently evaluate potential acquisition opportunities.
  • Ensure accurate categorization and allocation of leads within relevant portfolio verticals.
  • Effectively screen and qualify opportunities at the top of the acquisition funnel to support Portfolio Managers and operating teams.
  • Support the long-term build-out of Gemini’s LATAM/Brazil M&A presence by contributing to sourcing processes, knowledge sharing, and future team development.
  • Engage directly with founders, CEOs, and controlling shareholders, conducting high-quality M&A conversations to understand ownership dynamics, M&A insights, motivations, business insights and timing of a future, potential deal.
  • Qualify opportunities through initial commercial, operational, and financial assessment, filtering deals before internal escalation.
  • Coordinate internally with global teams (Perseus / CSI) to align on pipeline prioritization and strategic fit.
  • Maintain structured tracking of interactions and insights (CRM-driven), ensuring continuity and depth of relationship over time.


Relevant Experience & Competencies

  • At least three years of experience in M&A business development, with proven involvement in various aspects of M&A such as mandate origination (including private equity), initial contact with key decision-makers, deal negotiation, or client-facing roles in M&A or finance within the software or technology sector.
  • Experience in outbound deal origination planning.
  • Previous exposure on relationship-building meetings (virtual or in-person) with company owners to explore strategic M&A opportunities.
  • Demonstrated interest in building a long-term career in software investing, M&A, or corporate development.
  • Track record of high performance in business development, entrepreneurship, or other competitive environments.
  • Strong executive presence with the ability to confidently engage senior leaders, including CEOs, investors, and advisors.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working autonomously.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and results-driven with a strong sense of urgency.


Other Requirements

  • Willingness to travel occasionally within Brazil and broader LATAM as well as internationally to Canada, the U.S., and Portugal.
  • Professional working proficiency in both English and Portuguese is required.
  • Professional working proficiency in Spanish is a bonus.

Microsoft (Power Platform, Dataverse, SharePoint Online, M365/Entra, Copilot Studio)

Garantir aderência a controles de Copilot Studio (ex.: data policies, autenticação, conectores/ações, roteamento de ambientes, logs e rastreabilidade).

Desenvolver e dar suporte avançado (N3) em:Agentes no Copilot Studio (conectores, knowledge sources, autenticação, governança de publicação e segurança).

Power Apps (Canvas e/ou Model-driven conforme necessidade) e Power Automate (cloud flows, integrações e automações administrativas).

Diagnosticar incidentes complexos de makers/ambientes (erros de permissão, conectores, falhas de execução, limites/capacidade, problemas de DLP e ALM).

Administrar o Dataverse garantindo utilização dentro de KPIs (capacidade, performance, organização e governança do inventário).

Monitorar e corrigir causas de degradação (crescimento descontrolado, ambientes mal configurados, automações etc.).

Apoiar governança de dados/entidades relevantes ao CoE e relatórios operacionais.

Controlar e reportar custos e consumo de:Power Apps / Power Automate

Copilot Studio (agentes)

Propor medidas de otimização (racionalização de ambientes, consolidação/arquivamento, revisão de owners/licenças, desativação de ativos sem uso, melhoria de governança de conectores)

6) Operação do CoE (Power Platform + Copilot Studio)

Administrar e evoluir o Centro de Excelência (CoE): inventário, auditoria operacional, padrões, dashboards e rotinas automatizadas de governança.

Monitorar automações administrativas do CoE e garantirexecução/observabilidade.

Suportar a organização com orientações de governança e boas práticas (makers, owners, champions e times low-code).

Atuar em governança de SharePoint Online (estrutura, acessos, padrões de armazenamento, higiene/organização e integração com soluções Power Platform/Copilot)

Requisitos obrigatórios

Experiência prática com administração e governança do Power Platform (ambientes, DLP, conectores, capacidade, troubleshooting).

Conhecimento sólido de licenciamento e segurança no ecossistema Power Platform + M365.

Capacidade de desenvolver:Agentes no Copilot Studio (incluindo conectores/ações e governança)

Power Apps e Power Automate (para ser N3 de desenvolvimento e plataforma)

Vivência com Dataverse (administração, organização e sustentação operacional).

Experiência com SharePoint Online (admin/governança básica a intermediária e integrações).

Diferenciais (nice to have)

Experiência com CoE Starter Kit e práticas de adoção/governança em escala.

Conhecimento de logs/auditoria (Purview/Sentinel) aplicados a Copilot Studio e governança.

Cientista de Dados

Temos o propósito de tornar a saúde no Brasil mais acessível para todos. title: Senior Customer Education
description:
About the Role


Our education platform is a central learning hub for both customers and internal teams. With a large and growing base of users, we’ve reached a point where we need to scale the program more intentionally — with more structured learning paths, meaningful certifications, and content that directly connects to product adoption and retention.

We are looking for someone who combines strategic vision with strong execution skills: someone who can design an end-to-end educational program and turn it into measurable business results.


Key Responsibilities

  • Define the architecture of the education program — learning paths, certifications, and journeys aligned with the customer lifecycle and different user profiles
  • Develop and maintain courses and learning paths with high instructional quality and strong alignment with the product, in both Portuguese and English
  • Script educational videos and collaborate with recording and editing teams to ensure production consistency
  • Create and execute engagement strategies to convert users into active learners and drive progression through learning paths
  • Define and monitor program KPIs — activation, completion, and active engagement — connecting learning behavior to retention and expansion metrics
  • Turn usage data into portfolio decisions: what to prioritize, update, or discontinue
  • Collaborate with Product, Customer Success, and Support teams to keep content up to date and identify knowledge gaps that impact adoption
  • Support internal enablement initiatives


Requirements

  • Minimum of 4 years of experience in customer education, instructional design, or e-learning — preferably in B2B SaaS
  • Experience managing educational programs within LMS platforms (not just operating them, but designing structure and analyzing data)
  • Ability to connect learning behavior to business metrics such as adoption, retention, and expansion
  • Experience scripting and producing educational videos independently
  • Fluent communication in Portuguese and English — able to create and script content in both languages
  • Familiarity with AI tools applied to educational content production workflows


Nice to Have

  • Previous experience in B2B SaaS
  • Experience with Product-Led Growth (PLG) and Sales-Led Growth (SLG) models
  • Experience with product education and scalable learning programs
  • Experience with user reactivation strategies or engagement management in educational programs
  • Strategic use of AI to optimize content production, curation, and updates

Job Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”), which for the first time ever is hosted in South America in Brazil. Position Overview

The Head of Brand & Marketing at FWWC27 LTDA, which is FIFA’s Brazilian subsidiary responsible for the delivery of FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Brazil (TM), will be tasked to guide and implement brand and marketing plans, campaigns and activations in line with the marketing & communication strategy. This role is critical to the success of the first ever FIFA Women’s World Cup to be held in South America with a vision to unite the world through an unprecedented experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Key Responsibilities
  • Act as an extension to, and be part of the global MBBI (Marketing, Brand, Business Intelligence) team based in Zurich with dual reporting lines, for being a key representative to all Brand, Marketing and Promotion Tournament matters.
  • Responsible for all promotional aspects including any communications designed and required to support the commercial and marketing objectives of the tournament.
  • Be the main liaison for Host Country and Host City representatives, tournament executive leadership representing the MBBI team.
  • Lead the local, regional and national delivery of various marketing campaigns and initiatives related to, and beyond identified tournament milestones.
  • Lead a team of brand & marketing professionals on the ground, and ensure seamless cooperation, collaboration and integration with all relevant functional areas at FWWC27 LTDA and FIFA’s head office in Zurich, as well as any other functional areas such as legal, finance, etc.
  • Identify and communicate opportunities to create dedicated local, regional or national promotional activities that support the objectives of the tournament, the marketing strategy, or any relevant stakeholders such as commercial partners, media partners, host cities, and others.
  • Identify and drive commercial value through the marketing of the tournament’s brand assets and intellectual property, including but not limited to mascots, licensing & retail, the FIFA Fan Festival, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Trophy Tour, official music tracks/album/sonic identities, and other.
  • Contribute to, and drive implementation of ticketing & hospitality go-to-market strategy and activations plans.
  • Establish and maintain strong and impactful relationships with relevant partners, celebrities, influencers, key event organizers, agencies, etc.
  • Manage and maintain budget and liaise with the relevant colleagues in Zurich in all matters budget and spend.
  • Oversee the correct implementation and utilization of all in-market tournament brand asset implementations and applications including, but not limited to, event and stadium dressing, experiential marketing applications, retail branding, and any other use of the brand assets by FIFA’s internal and external stakeholders.
  • Manage procurement and legal processes (in compliance with FWWC27 LTDA policies and guidelines) as it relates to the tendering and contracting of local, regional or national suppliers, service providers, agencies, and other.
  • Manage and deliver all necessary reporting measures related to the tournament.
  • Drive and manage effective communications between the relevant functional areas and, in particular with the MBBI team in Zurich.
Your Profile
  • Bachelor’s degree or similar higher education in marketing, or a marketing related discipline.
  • Minimum 10 years’ experience in a relevant leadership position.
  • Proven experience delivering major brand & marketing plans.
  • Experience in the sports and/or entertainment industry is a major plus.
  • Experience working in a global or international environment.

  • Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills and the ability to manage up, down and sideways.

  • Conduct end-to-end analysis of large, complex datasets related to channel performance, user behavior, and market trends, translating raw data into actionable insights

Experience in articulating strategic issues and negotiating with C-level executives – experience in leading strategy consulting projects

description:
Descrição da vaga

A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Venha crescer com a gente!

Missão do cargo:

Liderar a implementação de estratégias e programas de segurança ocupacional, garantindo um ambiente de trabalho seguro para todas as operações na terra e no mar.

  • Desenvolver, implementar e gerenciar políticas e procedimentos de segurança específicos para operações onshore e offshore, alinhados com as regulamentações e padrões da empresa.

  • Monitorar e analisar indicadores-chave de segurança onshore e offshore, como taxas de incidentes, acidentes, e quase acidentes, utilizando esses dados para identificar tendências e áreas de melhoria.
  • Liderar investigações de incidentes de segurança onshore e offshore, identificando causas raiz e desenvolvendo planos de ação corretivos e preventivos para evitar recorrências.
  • Garantir a implementação eficaz das ações corretivas e comunicar os aprendizados com todas as partes interessadas.
  • Garantir que todas as operações onshore e offshore estejam em conformidade com as normas locais e internacionais de segurança e saúde ocupacional, incluindo as regulamentações da ANP e normas da OGP.
  • Supervisionar o uso adequado de EPIs e EPCs, garantindo que todos os equipamentos sejam de qualidade e estejam em conformidade com as normas de segurança.
  • Estabelecer e manter relações com autoridades regulatórias, organizações da indústria e prestadores de serviços para compartilhar melhores práticas e garantir a conformidade com as normas de segurança.
  • Formação com Superior completo em Engenharia, Segurança do Trabalho, Saúde Ocupacional ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência em funções relacionadas à saúde e segurança ocupacional, preferencialmente em ambientes industriais ou de grande porte.
  • Conhecimento sólido das normas regulamentadoras (NRs), técnicas de investigação de incidentes e outras legislações aplicáveis à saúde e segurança no trabalho.
  • Necessária experiência com O&G e regulamentos técnicos da ANP (SGSO, SGIP, SGSS, etc.).
  • Habilidades analíticas e capacidade de conduzir investigações de acidentes e análises de riscos.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação oral e escrita.
  • Gestão de pessoas.

For over 50 years our work has guided the decisions of the world’s most influential energy producers, utilities companies, financial institutions and governments.


Now, with the world’s energy system more complex and interconnected than ever before, sector-specific views are no longer enough. That’s why we’ve redefined what’s possible with Intelligence Connected.


By fusing our unparalleled proprietary data with the sharpest analytical minds, all supercharged by Synoptic AI, we deliver a clear, interconnected view of the entire value chain. Our trusted team of 2,700 experts across 30 countries breaks siloes and connects industries, markets and regions across the globe.


This empowers our customers to identify risk sooner, spot opportunities faster and recalibrate strategy with confidence – whether planning days, weeks, months or decades ahead.


Wood Mackenzie
Intelligence Connected

WoodMac.Com

Wood Mackenzie Brand Video

Wood Mackenzie Values

  • Inclusive – we succeed together
  • Trusting – we choose to trust each other
  • Customer committed – we put customers at the heart of our decisions
  • Future Focused – we accelerate change
  • Curious – we turn knowledge into action
We are looking for a senior executive (Director) to join our Upstream research team. Our oil and gas sector teams are located around the world and deliver research and consulting projects based on our assessment and valuation of thousands of individual assets. Together, we work with a range of clients, including national and major oil companies, operators, investment banks, and institutional investors.Role Purpose
  • To contribute to the strategic priorities and objectives of your region/sector/specialist area
  • To establish and maintain close working relationships with a range of senior/executive level clients across the Latin America region and to maintain currency on client priorities and enhance WoodMac's reputation for excellence
  • To support junior and middle managers in delivering excellence in overall team performance
  • To help recruit, develop and retain the right people and establish open, supportive and dynamic team environments which deliver success
  • To collaborate effectively with commercial colleagues in Latin America to build a more lucrative business in the region
  • To be accountable for delivering industry leading Upstream research
  • To be accountable for your team collaborating effectively with other sectors/specialist areas, such that there is close alignment on cross-team or pan-sectoral issues, and client expectations are addressed
  • To be a role model for WM values and culture, nurturing good practice and seeking continuous improvement
Key Responsibilities
  • Contributes to strategic planning and decision-making within business area, ensuring that programmes and objectives are aligned with strategic goals
  • Accountable for quality and effectiveness of content or work programmes in Latin America
  • To play an integral role in expanding our commercial business in Latin America, working very closely with commercial colleagues from the Sales and Consulting teams
  • To build and maintain a strong network within our Latin America clients and prospects
  • To contribute to our regional and global thought leadership research efforts
  • To communicate and share our industry leading research and opinions with executive clients and prospects.
About you
  • MSc or equivalent level qualification
  • A minimum of 10+ years of relevant, professional experience in the Upstream sector with exposure across the value chain, from exploration to production
  • Comprehensive knowledge of the oil and gas markets of the Latin America region
  • Extensive knowledge of the global energy industry and the Energy Transition
  • Deep experience in stakeholder engagement and management
  • Strong blend of technical skills and experience and demonstrable commercial acumen
  • A track record in demonstrating differentiated values and behaviours
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Demonstrable curiosity with a track record of impactful innovation
  • Excellent data reading, manipulation and analysis skills.

Expectations

  • We are a hybrid working company and the successful applicant will be required to be physically present in the office at least 2 days per week to foster and contribute to a collaborative environment. Full-time remote working is not an option for this role.
  • Due to the global nature of the team, a degree of flexible working will be required to accommodate different time zones.

Equal Opportunities

We are an equal opportunities employer. This means we are committed to recruiting the best people regardless of their race, colour, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability or protected veteran status. You can find out more about your rights under the law at

If you are applying for a role and have a physical or mental disability, we will support you with your application or through the hiring process.

description:

Desde dezembro de 2024 a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Cardoso Fontes .

OHospital Cardoso Fontes, é direcionado ao atendimento de média e alta complexidade. É uma das principais referências hospitalares da Zona Oeste do Rio de Janeiro. A unidade é reconhecida por sua atuação na área de fisioterapia oncológica, ginecologia, nefrologia (sistema urinário) e tratamentos em crianças com insuficiência renal, pneumologia e urologia.

Responsável pelo atendimento especializado a crianças e adolescentes com distúrbios neurológicos, atuando no diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de condições que afetam o desenvolvimento do sistema nervoso central e periférico.   • Realizar consultas ambulatoriais e hospitalares com enfoque neurológico pediátrico.

  • Prescrever medicamentos e tratamentos adequados de acordo com o diagnóstico.
  • Elaborar relatórios, laudos médicos e pareceres técnicos.
  • Acompanhar o desenvolvimento neurológico dos pacientes, realizando avaliações periódicas.
  • Trabalhar de forma integrada com psicólogos, fonoaudiólogos, terapeutas ocupacionais, fisioterapeutas e demais profissionais.
  • Orientar familiares sobre diagnósticos, tratamentos e prognósticos.
  • Participar de reuniões clínicas, discussões de caso e programas de educação continuada.

title: Qa/Qc Manager - Data Centers
description: The Client Datacenter People is working with the largest building commissioning and operational risk management providers in the world. What the Job Involves… Actively supports the Company’s commitment to safety and its core values. Performs quality inspections in accordance with program quality control documentation. Participate and guide project quality control from kick-off until hand-off. Provides oversight of the implementation of the QA/QC management system at site. Coordinates the quality inspections with the site sub-contractors and vendors. Coordinates with the customers representative on all quality matters. Provides oversight in the distribution of relevant QA/QC documentation to site subcontractors while reviewing that completed documentation is stored appropriately upon completion. Verifies that the quality related site activities are in accordance with the design documents and program standards. Participates in the internal and external site audits. Coordinates all the quality site inspections through the Contractor QC team. Ensures all quality control documentation is compiled and competed for as-built hand over through the Contractor QC team. Provide review and reporting of all non-conformance reports and undertake remedial action. Monitors the implementation of the approved site QC Plan. Completes and coordinates the approval of the sites QC technical submittals to the customer. Coordinates with the Client and Contractor QA/QC team on all quality issues. Coordinate and chair the QA/QC site weekly meetings with the Contractor QC personnel. Assures all technical documents relative to site quality control are of current status. We’re Looking for Someone Who… Data center commissioning/QA experience. Has a Bachelor's degree in an engineering discipline preferred. Has Certifications in Lean, Six Sigma, Quality Auditor, and/or Quality Engineer a plus. Is experienced with ISO 9001 certification process. Has a history and experience driving improved Quality at scale. Is able to work seamlessly across functional and department lines. Has experience with standard data center equipment to include: electrical distribution equipment from switchgear to panelboards, VFDs, low voltage power and moulded case circuit breakers, overhead IT busway, Diesel Generators, DX units, air handlers, water treatment equipment, BMS modules, and hot aisle containment accessories. Is able to travel domestically and internationally as needed. We regret that due to the high volume of applications we are unable to acknowledge each one. Please bear in mind that if you are selected for interview we will contact you within the next seven days.

title: Estágio Em Ti
description:

Identificar,viabilizar a implementação e gerenciar soluções de tecnologia internas e/ou externas para aumentar a eficácia e eficiência operacional, qualidade dos serviços e nível de governança da seguradora, de acordo com as necessidades identificadas/reportadas;
Gerenciar, em conjunto com o coordenador da área, o desenvolvimento da infraestrutura, da implantação e atualização de sistemas, softwares e de soluções de tecnologia;
Atender demandas do CEO, COO e do CIO e demais diretores quando solicitado;
Aplicar processos e políticas de governança da empresa e contribuir com melhorias;
Planejar, documentar,executar e testar estratégias e procedimentos de contingências, visando a segurança de dados e informações;
Auxiliar nasatividades de auditorias e continuidade dos serviços;
Manter monitoramento,avaliação de desempenho e qualificação das equipes, visando a manutenção da motivação, a fim de obter os melhores resultados das atividades da área e a busca pelas melhores soluções técnicas;
Buscar tendências de mercado e necessidades identificadas na seguradora para evolução tecnológica dos serviços e soluções ofertados ao mercado;
Relacionar-se com fornecedores de produtos e serviços de tecnologias, garantindo atendimento aos interesses e às necessidades da empresa;
Realizar gestão, acompanhamento e cumprimento dos contratos firmados pela área de TI;
Cumprir o orçamento anual previsto para a área de TI;
Gerenciar asinterações com os provedores de soluções externas;
Participar de reuniões periódicas com a Diretoria de TI;
Produzir relatório mensal demonstrando resultados, incidentes e monitoramento das atividades em andamento;
Garantir integração de produtos e sistemas;
Auxiliar na validaçãode soluções técnicas;
Auxiliar na gestão, revisão e conclusão de pontos de auditorias;
Analisar e propor melhorias em relação a indicadores de ocorrências;
Assegurar o cumprimento de normas e padrões;
Acompanhar oprocesso de homologação de equipamentos e softwares de soluções externas visando a transformação e inovação;
Conduzir reuniões comequipes de trabalho;
Auxiliar no desenvolvimento e implementação de workshops e treinamentos voltados para a fomentação da transformação & inovação no âmbito da seguradora. Requisitos Experiência mínima de seis (6) anos como Gerente de TI, com atuação comprovada em infraestrutura, redes e suporte (Service Desk), sendo desejável experiência no setor de seguros;
Vivência em projetos de transformação e simplificação digital de processos, gestão de mudanças e operações em seguros;
Experiência na definição de KPIs (tempos de resposta, resolução) e níveis de serviço (SLAs);
Domínio de ferramentas de ITSM (exp. Freshservice, ServiceNow). Nível de instrução Superior em Sistemas de Informação, Tecnologia da Informação, Ciências da Computação, Análise de Sistemas e/ou cursos afins;
MBA, Especialização ou Pós-Graduação em Gestão de TI, Transformação & Inovação e/ou áreas afins. Cursos/Certificações/Conhecimentos específicos: Inglês fluente;
Experiência em Gestãode Projetos e Metodologia Agile;
ITIL Foundation ou Superior (crucial para governança de serviços);
PMP ou metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban);
Cisco (CCNA/CCNP), Microsoft (MCSE), Cloud Solutions Architect. Desejável: Fluência em francês ou espanhol Competências: Liderança de equipes técnicas, excelente comunicação, capacidade de trabalhar em ambiente multidisciplinar, dinâmico e sob pressão (especialmente em momentos de crises, como DR e Alta Disponibilidade), visão sistêmica, visão estratégica de negócio, tomada de decisão, negociação, organização, raciocínio lógico e resiliência. title: Analista Financeiro
description:
A Lola From Rio vem crescendo e revolucionando o mundo dos cosméticos e, para acompanhar este crescimento, estamos com oportunidades para você que é apaixonado(a) por beleza. Nosso time Financeiro está com oportunidade para você que deseja aplicar seus conhecimentos e desenvolver habilidades em uma empresa que vem revolucionando o mercado de cosméticos no Brasil e no exterior. Escolha Lola, Escolha Ser Feliz! Cargo: Gerente Financeiro Missão do cargo Responsável pela gestão integrada das atividades de tesouraria, contas a pagar e contas a receber, crédito e cobrança, assegurando o controle eficiente do fluxo de caixa, a liquidez da companhia, níveis adequados de inadimplência e a correta execução das obrigações financeiras. O que você vai fazer no dia a dia Principais Responsabilidades: Gestão de Tesouraria - Elaborar a posição de caixa, fluxo de caixa (direto e indireto) e indicadores financeiros, acompanhando projeções de curto, médio e longo prazo.
- Monitorar e controlar a posição diária de caixa, garantindo a disponibilidade de recursos para as operações.
- Gerenciar aplicações financeiras de curto prazo, resgates e movimentações bancárias.
- Acompanhar e negociar operações de empréstimos e financiamentos.
- Manter relacionamento operacional com instituições financeiras, adquirentes e empresas de meios de pagamento.
- Identificar oportunidades de melhoria na gestão do capital de giro e otimização da liquidez. Contas a Pagar - Supervisionar o processamento e a execução de pagamentos a fornecedores, tributos e demais obrigações financeiras.
- Garantir a correta validação, aprovação e programação dos pagamentos.
- Monitorar prazos e políticas internas, evitando atrasos ou penalidades.
- Controlar e acompanhar provisões financeiras e compromissos futuros. Contas a Receber, Crédito e Cobrança - Acompanhar os processos de crédito e cobrança de clientes.
- Monitorar a inadimplência e o aging de contas a receber.
- Apoiar estratégias de cobrança e negociação com clientes.
- Contribuir para a melhoria do ciclo de conversão de caixa.
- Utilizar informações de bureau de crédito para análise.
- Analisar demonstrações financeiras para definição de limites de crédito.
- Atuar na definição e revisão de políticas de crédito.
- Gerenciar processos de cobrança interna e externa.
- Implementar ferramentas de automação nos processos de contas a receber, crédito e cobrança. Governança e Controles - Monitorar indicadores como prazo médio de recebimento (DSO), prazo médio de pagamento (DPO) e ciclo financeiro.
- Garantir o cumprimento das políticas financeiras e controles internos.
- Apoiar os processos de fechamento financeiro e contábil, incluindo conciliações das áreas de tesouraria, AP e AR.
- Atuar em auditorias internas e externas.
- Garantir a rastreabilidade e documentação das transações financeiras. Requisitos: - Graduação em Administração, Economia, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas.
- Experiência sólida em tesouraria, contas a pagar e contas a receber.
- Excel avançado.
- Experiência com sistemas ERP (SAP). Desejável: - Inglês avançado.
- Conhecimento em Power BI.
- Vivência em indústrias ou empresas de bens de consumo. Regime de Trabalho: CLT - Segunda à sexta-feira (100% presencial) Região de Atuação: Jacarepaguá | Rio de Janeiro/RJ O que oferecemos: - Vale Alimentação ou Refeição (Pluxee) - Cesta Básica - Plano de Saúde AMIL (Extensivo aos dependentes diretos) - Plano Odontológico AMIL (Extensivo aos dependentes diretos) - Seguro de Vida - Descontos em Produtos da Marca - WellHub (Gympass)

prior work with medical, clinical, or industrial apps is a strong plus.Team Fit & Work Style:- Ability to work from written requirements without dedicated UX research support- Self-directed and comfortable working in small teams- Comfortable working within established design systems rather than creating new visual languages- Strong English communication skills, both written and spoken- Experience working in distributed remote teams and async environmentsNice to Have:- Experience in laboratory, life sciences, or medical software- Experience working with design systems within the Apple ecosystemEngagement: Short-term contract, 5–6 weeks at a part-time capacity (80 hours per month) with PST work hours overlap.Timeline: Project kick-off scheduled for early May*Please note our partner is only looking for part-time dedicated team members who are eager to integrate within their team

Formação: Graduação em Design de Produto, Moda, Design de Moda ou áreas correlatas. IV. Diferenciais Experiência específica no desenvolvimento de sneakers ou calçados utilitários para o nicho Athleisure. Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to prioritize issues based on business impact. Experience collaborating with mobile teams (React Native is a plus). Advanced English proficiency is required, as you will work directly with US-based clients. Audit and stabilize third-party integrations such as payments and external platforms. Collaborate with QA and stakeholders to validate functionality and prioritize fixes. Support release readiness and launch execution ensuring system stability. Enforce a feature-freeze approach focused on stabilization and critical fixes. Contribute to defining a post-launch roadmap to support scalability and future development. Continuously improve system security, performance, and operational stability. Qualifications 5+ years of experience in Node.Js backend development. Experience working with legacy systems, system stabilization, or technical recovery projects. Strong experience with AWS, CI/CD pipelines, and PostgreSQL. Solid understanding of backend security and API integrations. Advanced English proficiency. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Law, or related fields. Experience in Billing, Invoicing, Contract Administration, or Revenue Operations. Strong knowledge of Order-to-Cash (O2C) processes. Hands-on experience with ERP systems (TOTVS Protheus highly desirable). Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (controls, reconciliations, reporting). Working knowledge of indirect taxation and invoice compliance. Professional proficiency in English. Preferred Qualifications Experience in telecommunications, infrastructure, or technology services. Exposure to enterprise or Tier-1 customers. Familiarity with invoice submission portals, acceptance workflows, and billing SLAs. Experience operating in high-volume, month-end driven environments. title: Técnico De Segurança Do Trabalho
description: Somos o Grupo SADA! Um grupo referência em transporte e logística, além de atuação em diversos segmentos de negócios movidos por milhares de pessoas dispostas a darem o seu melhor, todos os dias. Somos serviços, informação, indústria, concessionárias, energia limpa, esporte e responsabilidade social movimentando a vida das pessoas há mais de 45 anos, e é isso que nos faz ir mais longe. Venha para uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar no Brasil. Uma empresa que cuida das pessoas e se preocupa em proporcionar um ambiente de trabalho cada vez mais saudável e seguro, pois queremos que nossos colaboradores sempre sintam orgulho de trabalhar aqui. Somos plurais por natureza, um grupo diverso em negócios e pessoas. Acreditamos que as diferenças somam e movimentam, e é por isso que o Grupo SADA quer conhecer você. Todas as nossas vagas são extensivas as Pessoas com Deficiência e profissionais reabilitados do INSS. Quem sabe alguma oportunidade combina com você. Resumo da Posição: Se você busca atuar em um ambiente dinâmico, com desafios reais e foco em segurança do trabalho, esta vaga pode ser ideal para você! Estamos em busca de um(a) Técnico(a) de Segurança do Trabalho III com forte atuação operacional, capacidade analítica e comprometimento com a cultura de prevenção. Atuar na gestão de Segurança do Trabalho III em operações logísticas, com foco na prevenção de acidentes, controle de riscos críticos (prensamento, queda, movimentação de cargas e interação homem x máquina) e garantia de conformidade legal, contribuindo diretamente para a redução de incidentes e melhoria da performance operacional. Oportunidade: Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho III Local do Trabalho: R. Carlos Seidl, 993 - Caju, Rio de Janeiro - RJ,. Modelo de Trabalho: 100% Presencial - Horário: 07:30 às 17:30 TÉCNICO DE SEGURANÇA DO TRABALHO III – GRUPO SADA Principais responsabilidades: Garantir cumprimento das Normas Regulamentadoras (NR 01, 06, 11, 12, 20, 33 e 35) e legislações aplicáveis ao transporte de cargas. Elaborar, revisar e gerir documentos técnicos: PGR, APR, PT, relatórios e indicadores de SST Realizar inspeções de campo em operações logísticas (pátio, carregamento, descarregamento, amarração de cargas, movimentação de contêineres). Identificar e controlar riscos críticos, principalmente: Prensamento de membros Falta de bloqueio/LOTO Quedas de altura Falhas na interação homem x máquina Conduzir investigação de acidentes com foco em causa raiz (Brainstorming, Diagrama de Ishikawa, 5 Porquês). Desenvolver e ministrar treinamentos técnicos e operacionais. Gerenciar EPIs e apoiar especificação de EPCs conforme riscos da operação. Atuar na gestão de dados e sistemas de SST (ex: SOC). Apoiar auditorias, simulados de emergência e planos de ação. Atuar junto à operação e liderança com foco em disciplina operacional e comportamento seguro. REQUISITOS NECESSÁRIOS (Obrigatórios): Formação Técnica em Segurança do Trabalho com registro no MTE. Experiência mínima de 5 anos na área. Sólido conhecimento em NRs aplicáveis à operação logística. Experiência com: Gestão de PGR, APR e indicadores Investigação de acidentes Atuação em campo (perfil operacional) Conhecimento em sistemas de gestão (preferencialmente SOC). Domínio do Pacote Office. COMPETÊNCIAS COMPORTAMENTAIS: Forte atuação em campo (não apenas administrativo) Capacidade de identificar riscos e propor soluções práticas Boa comunicação e influência sobre equipes operacionais Perfil analítico, proativo e com foco em resultado Postura firme em segurança (valor inegociável) REQUISITOS DIFERENCIAIS: Experiência com transporte de cargas perigosas (ANTT) Experiência com: Logística e transporte rodoviário de cargas Operações com veículos pesados ou contêineres Carretas cegonha Operações de carga/descarga de veículos Amarração de cargas Conhecimento em LOTO (bloqueio e etiquetagem) Vivência com ISO 45001 / auditorias Atuação em programas de comportamento seguro Por que fazer parte do Grupo SADA? No Grupo SADA, acreditamos que a comunicação é um elo essencial entre pessoas, propósito e resultados. Aqui, você encontrará um ambiente desafiador, colaborativo e em constante transformação, onde suas ideias e seu talento podem gerar impacto real. Venha fazer parte dessa história! Candidate-se e contribua para fortalecer a marca e a cultura do Grupo SADA. NOSSA HISTÓRIA Para contar a história do nosso grupo empresarial precisamos voltar ao Brasil dos anos 70, quando um jovem visionário desembarcava da Europa trazendo objetivos bem audaciosos. Ali, iniciava a trajetória da SADA, com a implantação de uma pequena transportadora na região metropolitana de Belo Horizonte. Fundada em 4 de agosto de 1976, na cidade de Contagem, em Minas Gerais, a SADA Transportes e Armazéns S/A é criada, a partir da necessidade de atender as demandas de armazenagem e distribuição automobilística no país. Sete anos depois, em 1983, a empresa é transferida para Betim em um terreno de cerca de 31 mil metros quadrados, 23 vezes menor que a área ocupada pela empresa atualmente. “Ainda muito jovem, cheguei aqui vindo da Itália com a tarefa de montar a SADA no Brasil junto com a chegada da Fiat”, conta Vittorio Medioli, fundador presidente do Grupo SADA. Assim como seu precursor, a origem do nome SADA também é italiana.

title: Technical Solutions Architect
description:
Associate Solutions Architect – TestBox

Remote — Must be based in Rio de Janeiro or Niterói

$36,000 USD / year + equity & benefits

About TestBox

TestBox was founded with a bold mission : to fundamentally transform how software is bought and sold. We're building an innovative platform that empowers buyers with transparent, interactive software experiences, while equipping sellers with powerful tools to deliver exceptional buying and onboarding journeys. Our core technologies—synthetic data, intelligent orchestration, and our unique product graph—help teams achieve faster implementations, clearer insights, and increase trust with their customers.

At TestBox, we're not just improving demos; we're building the next generation infrastructure for software transactions, creating seamless experiences from initial interest to successful onboarding and beyond.

We're a fast-growing startup built by a team that values experimentation, velocity, and customer impact. We're backed by world-class investors and are building a platform that's disrupting the traditional B2B sales motion.

Role Overview

As a Solutions Architect at TestBox, you'll be at the heart of our customer experience—designing, building, and delivering high-impact demo and POC environments that drive sales success for our customers.

You’ll lead technical delivery, participate in agile rituals like standups and retros, and act as a trusted consultant to help customers design stories that resonate. You’ll also be expected to innovate and move fast—this isn't a role for someone looking to just “follow the playbook.”

To succeed here, you’ll need to be curious, flexible, and scrappy. You’ll work cross-functionally with engineering, product, and go-to-market teams, and you’ll use AI tools (including our own) daily to boost your productivity, generate data, and solve complex problems creatively.

Key Responsibilities

Project Ownership & Delivery

  • Lead end-to-end implementation of customer demo and POC environments—from kickoff through delivery.
  • Participate in daily standups, sprint planning, and retros; communicate blockers and drive timelines forward.
  • Collaborate across customer engineering, solutions, and product teams to ensure smooth handoffs and clear technical execution.

Customer Storytelling & Consulting

  • Help customers craft compelling demo narratives grounded in real-world buyer personas, workflows, and industry context.
  • Design fictional yet realistic companies and user journeys to simulate how the product solves specific problems.
  • Advise on best practices for demo structure, content pacing, and emotional resonance.

Environment Implementation

  • Configure CRM, support, or comms tools with customized fields, workflows, and industry templates.
  • Simulate real user behavior using automation, time-based triggers, and behavioral scripting. (We integrate AI-powered interactions where relevant to enhance realism)

AI-Driven Efficiency

  • Leverage AI tools (including LLMs like OpenAI and Anthropic, automation platforms) to speed up data generation, ticket writing, and documentation.
  • Continuously explore ways to innovate and disrupt traditional workflows using AI—TestBox is built on this mindset.

Documentation & Ticket Writing

  • Create detailed technical tickets and documentation to support repeatable environment setup and engineering handoffs.
  • Maintain internal knowledge resources for templates, industry scenarios, and technical edge cases.

Who You Are

  • You're fluent in english.
  • You're resourceful, autonomous, and outcomes-driven —comfortable leading projects with limited structure.
  • You think like a builder, act like an owner, and communicate like a product manager.
  • You thrive in startups : ambiguity excites you, pivots don't scare you, and you prioritize speed over perfection.
  • You believe AI is a power tool , not a novelty—and you're already using it to make your work better and faster.
  • You're comfortable translating between customer needs and technical systems, and enjoy being at the intersection of product, engineering, and sales.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 3–5 years in Solutions Architecture, Sales Engineering, Implementation, or similar technical consulting roles.
  • Ability to write and manage technical tickets and documentation for delivery teams.
  • Familiarity with APIs, automation logic, and data formats like CSV and JSON.
  • Experience working in agile environments (standups, retros, ticket grooming, etc.).
  • Experience using AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, text‑to‑speech engines, automation platforms) to drive efficiency, draft technical documentation, create demo content, or solve complex problems.
  • Bonus : Familiarity with synthetic data or interactive storytelling in demos. Completion of AI‑focused courses, certifications, or hands‑on projects.

Why Join TestBox

  • Shape the future of how software is bought and sold.
  • Build with a team that values autonomy, curiosity, and experimentation.
  • Use AI every day—not as a gimmick, but as a core productivity engine.
  • Make a direct impact in a high-growth startup redefining the demo experience.

Benefits

  • Generous equity package for meaningful ownership
  • Prioritization of your professional growth, with dedicated career development support
  • Flexible, unlimited PTO with a minimum expectation for recharge
  • Mental Health benefits
  • Fitness allowances
  • Learning allowances
  • Remote and office setup allowances to ensure productive and comfortable working environments

title: Head of Brand, Marketing and Promotion
description:
Job Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”), which for the first time ever is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Department: Commercial & Marketing

Location: Brazil

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Position Overview

The Head of Brand & Marketing at FWWC27 LTDA, which is FIFA’s Brazilian subsidiary responsible for the delivery of FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Brazil (TM), will be tasked to guide and implement brand and marketing plans, campaigns and activations in line with the marketing & communication strategy. This role is critical to the success of the first ever FIFA Women’s World Cup to be held in South America with a vision to unite the world through an unprecedented experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as an extension to, and be part of the global MBBI (Marketing, Brand, Business Intelligence) team based in Zurich with dual reporting lines, for being a key representative to all Brand, Marketing and Promotion Tournament matters.
  • Responsible for all promotional aspects including any communications designed and required to support the commercial and marketing objectives of the tournament.
  • Be the main liaison for Host Country and Host City representatives, tournament executive leadership representing the MBBI team.
  • Lead the local, regional and national delivery of various marketing campaigns and initiatives related to, and beyond identified tournament milestones.
  • Lead a team of brand & marketing professionals on the ground, and ensure seamless cooperation, collaboration and integration with all relevant functional areas at FWWC27 LTDA and FIFA’s head office in Zurich, as well as any other functional areas such as legal, finance, etc.
  • Identify and communicate opportunities to create dedicated local, regional or national promotional activities that support the objectives of the tournament, the marketing strategy, or any relevant stakeholders such as commercial partners, media partners, host cities, and others.
  • Identify and drive commercial value through the marketing of the tournament’s brand assets and intellectual property, including but not limited to mascots, licensing & retail, the FIFA Fan Festival, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Trophy Tour, official music tracks/album/sonic identities, and other.
  • Contribute to, and drive implementation of ticketing & hospitality go-to-market strategy and activations plans.
  • Establish and maintain strong and impactful relationships with relevant partners, celebrities, influencers, key event organizers, agencies, etc.
  • Manage and maintain budget and liaise with the relevant colleagues in Zurich in all matters budget and spend.
  • Oversee the correct implementation and utilization of all in-market tournament brand asset implementations and applications including, but not limited to, event and stadium dressing, experiential marketing applications, retail branding, and any other use of the brand assets by FIFA’s internal and external stakeholders.
  • Manage procurement and legal processes (in compliance with FWWC27 LTDA policies and guidelines) as it relates to the tendering and contracting of local, regional or national suppliers, service providers, agencies, and other.
  • Manage and deliver all necessary reporting measures related to the tournament.
  • Drive and manage effective communications between the relevant functional areas and, in particular with the MBBI team in Zurich.

Your Profile

  • Bachelor’s degree or similar higher education in marketing, or a marketing related discipline.
  • Minimum 10 years’ experience in a relevant leadership position.
  • Proven experience delivering major brand & marketing plans.
  • Experience in the sports and/or entertainment industry is a major plus.
  • Experience working in a global or international environment.
  • Proven track record in managing a team in a matrix or similar structure.
  • Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills and the ability to manage up, down and sideways.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills.
  • Profound knowledge of Brazilian and South American markets and culture.
  • Ability to work to deadlines and stress resilient.
  • Financial and budget management.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written).
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Additional Information

  • Seniority level: Mid-Senior level
  • Employment type: Contract
  • Job function: Marketing and Sales

  • Conduct end-to-end analysis of large, complex datasets related to channel performance, user behavior, and market trends, translating raw data into actionable insights

Experience in articulating strategic issues and negotiating with C-level executives – experience in leading strategy consulting projects

  • Experience in the online travel or e-commerce industry

We are looking for passionate geoscientists to join our Interpretation Team at Viridien. In this role, you will contribute directly to Velocity Model Building (VMB) by performing seismic interpretation and providing essential geological support to Processing and VMB teams. From picking horizons to building velocity scenarios, you will work at the intersection of geology, geophysics, and advanced imaging tools, helping to transform complex seismic data into meaningful insights. Your work will play a critical role in delivering high-quality results to our clients and shaping decisions across energy and earth-data projects.

You will join a diverse group of interpreters, geologists, and geophysicists who collaborate closely with Processing and VMB teams. At Viridien, collaboration is key — you will be encouraged to bring your ideas forward and grow in a supportive environment.

Qualifications

  • Master’s or PhD in Geophysics, Geology, or related field; or equivalent professional experience in the Oil & Gas industry.

A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. Overview

Join to apply for the Research Fellow-3 role at Inside Higher Ed .

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The NDCF Computational Research Fellow will participate in the Neurodegeneration Computational Fellows Training Program (NDCF) at Howard University, developing and applying computational skills in neuroscience research. Under the mentorship of host labs, the fellow will contribute to analyzing datasets related to neurodegenerative diseases, such as Alzheimer’s, Parkinson’s, or traumatic brain injury (TBI), advancing the understanding of disease mechanisms. This role supports the program’s mission to train researchers in advanced mathematics, data analysis, and bioinformatics for neurodegeneration research.

Supervisory Authority

This position has no supervisory authority. The fellow will work directly under the supervision of a principal investigator or mentor in a host lab affiliated with the NDCF program, receiving guidance on research tasks and computational training.

Nature And Scope

The NDCF Computational Research Fellow will engage in interdisciplinary research within a host lab at Howard University or a partner institution, such as NIH/NINDS, focusing on computational approaches to neurodegeneration. The fellow will gain hands-on experience analyzing neurophysiological, genomic, or imaging data using tools like Python, R, or machine learning frameworks. The fellow will collaborate with researchers, other fellows, and faculty, participating in lab meetings and NDCF symposia. The role is designed to support professional growth by developing skills in data analysis and contributing to research publications. External opportunities may include presenting at conferences or collaborating with partners in the Neurodegeneration Challenge Network (NDCN) under the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Assist in analyzing datasets (e.g., MRI, genomic, or microbiome data) using computational tools under the guidance of a mentor, identifying patterns or biomarkers in neurodegenerative diseases.
  • Learn and apply statistical or machine learning methods to support research on disease mechanisms, following lab protocols.
  • Support data processing tasks, such as image analysis or sequence alignment, using provided software or scripts.
  • Prepare research summaries and present findings at NDCF symposia, lab meetings, or external conferences.
  • Contribute to team discussions, collaborating with lab members to integrate computational and experimental findings.
  • Maintain accurate records of research activities and adhere to ethical standards in data handling and reporting.

Core Competencies

  • Computational Aptitude: Basic familiarity with programming (e.g., Python, R) or data analysis tools, with a strong interest in learning advanced computational techniques.
  • Analytical Thinking: Ability to approach complex datasets with curiosity and apply structured methods to derive meaningful insights under mentorship.
  • Collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills to work effectively in interdisciplinary teams, including researchers, students, and faculty.
  • Communication: Clear written and verbal communication to present research progress and engage with scientific audiences.
  • Adaptability: Eagerness to acquire new skills and adapt to evolving research tools and methodologies in a training-focused environment.

Minimum Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in neuroscience, biology, computer science, bioinformatics, or a related field.
  • Experience: Some exposure to programming, data analysis, or neuroscience research through coursework, internships, or personal projects. No prior expertise required.
  • Skills: Basic familiarity with computational tools (e.g., Python, R, MATLAB, or command-line interfaces) or a strong interest in learning these skills. Introductory knowledge of statistics or data visualization is a plus.
  • Other: Demonstrated interest in neurodegeneration research and the ability to work collaboratively under mentorship guidance.

title: Funcionários da Faetec passam a receber vale-alimentação
description:
Funcionários da Faetec passam a receber vale-alimentação

A Fundação de Apoio à Escola Técnica (Faetec), vinculada à Secretaria de Estado de Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação, iniciou nesta quinta-feira (26) a distribuição do vale-alimentação a todos os funcionários da Rede. A partir de agora, servidores de carreira e de contratos temporários podem contar com um cartão com valor mensal que pode chegar a R$660,00.
Os funcionários com carga horária de 20h semanais irão receber o valor mensal de R$330,00. Para os profissionais que trabalham 40h e 60h será depositado a quantia de R$660,00. O cartão poderá ser utilizado em estabelecimentos parceiros e já está sendo distribuído a todos os 5.162 funcionários, que atuam em mais de 120 unidades da Rede, em 63 municípios do Estado.
Além da Presidente da Faetec, Caroline Alves, o Secretário de Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação, Mauro Azevedo Neto, esteve presente na entrega do primeiro vale-alimentação a um servidor da Rede. Ele acredita que o benefício chega para reconhecer os esforços do servidor.
“Sempre que tínhamos reuniões, a Carol trazia essa pauta como valorização do servidor, então é um prazer estar aqui no momento dessa entrega. Sou filho de professora da rede estadual de educação e sei como os auxílios aos servidores e a valorização do servidor são importantes. Na secretaria já fui assistente, assessor, chefe de gabinete, subsecretário e hoje estou como secretário, então sei que são os servidores que constroem a secretaria e a Faetec. O governador está sendo um parceiro nas pautas de educação, a gente sabe que o orçamento é curto, mas sempre que valoriza o servidor, ele é bem gasto”, declarou o S ecretário.
Os servidores e temporários recebem o vale-alimentação com o benefício referente aos meses de setembro e outubro. A medida não só reconhece e valoriza os profissionais que atuam nas unidades da Faetec, mas contribui para um ambiente de trabalho mais saudável e motivador.
Para Caroline Alves, presidente da Faetec, a entrega do vale-alimentação só foi possível graças ao empenho dos próprios funcionários, que se dedicam diariamente para que a Faetec continue sendo uma instituição de excelência. A gestora aproveitou a ocasião para agradecer a parceria da Secretaria.
“Essa é uma causa dos servidores de muitos anos e é uma construção que estamos fazendo juntos, sempre tenho esse cuidado de ouvir o outro, dialogar e construir isso junto. Eu acredito que essa entrega é importante para a nossa Rede e não posso deixar de mencionar o secretário que nos ajudou, abriu caminhos e deu suporte nessa construção”, concluiu a presidente da Faetec.
